verdict.rationale: GlitchTip docs confirm basic alerting: new-issue emails to team members plus a webhook recipient option (glitchtip-docs-4), but there's no evidence of native Slack/PagerDuty connectors, per-rule thresholds (frequency spike, affected-user count), or routing by project/environment/severity — only generic 'team' based routing (glitchtip-docs-3). missing for 10: native Slack/PagerDuty integrations, configurable alert thresholds (frequency spike, affected-user count), environment/severity-based routing rules, and any documentation or community confirmation of these granular alerting features.
